note: For a German working translation with notes on vocabulary and grammar, see Frank Oborski: _Vulgata-Lesebuch. Clavis Vulgatae. Lesestücke aus der lateinischen Bibel mit didaktischer Übersetzung, Anmerkungen und Glossar_. Stuttgart 2022 (343 pp.), pp. 274–276.

(_caritas_) _non agit perperam_ – (love) dealeth not perversely (Douay Version), rendering Greek περπερεύεται – does not vaunt itself, is not boastful. The Latin translation may be a mere guess, based on the similarity of the Greek and the Latin words. Another possibility is that the translator thought of _perperus_ = boaster (though this exact meaning is not listed in the dictionaries). – Richards, pp. xiii and 90.
